calculation.expression: rank_cs(((log(close/close[-20]) + 0.35*(-log(close/close[-5]))) * (0.65 + 0.70*cross_sectional_mean(1[close > SMA(close,60)]))) with asset gate 1[close > SMA(close,60)], lag 1)
calculation.description: Ranks 20-day momentum adjusted by a modest five-day reversal term, scales it by the contemporaneous fraction of tradable assets above their 60-day moving average, and excludes assets below their own 60-day trend. All inputs are lagged one completed trading day before use.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 10-day IC in 2020-22, 2024, 2026-27 and 2030; materially negative in 2023 and 2028-29. Recent 2031 sample is only 6 dates and is not treated as conclusive. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty; dates generally meet the >=8 valid instrument requirement.
